_description: Integration contract for the TinyUNet SAR oil-spill segmentation model. This document is the authoritative specification for all backend integration partners. Do not integrate a heuristic detector in place of this contract.
_status: AWAITING_CHECKPOINT — checkpoint will be placed at artifacts/sar_unet.pt after Zenodo training run completes.
checkpoint_format: PyTorch state_dict saved via torch.save({model_state, in_channels, base_channels, model_version, epoch, val_dice_f1, val_iou, threshold, dataset, sar_channels, preprocessing})

input_contract.tensor_shape: [2, H, W] — no fixed H or W; TinyUNet uses fully-convolutional architecture
input_contract.batch_dimension: Add batch dim before forward pass: input[None, ...] gives [1, 2, H, W]
input_contract.channel_0: VV polarization — linear sigma0, raw from GeoTIFF band 1
input_contract.channel_1: VH polarization — linear sigma0, raw from GeoTIFF band 1
input_contract.sar_scale: linear_sigma0_raw — do NOT convert to dB before preprocessing

preprocessing_detail.scope: per_scene — percentiles computed from each tile independently, NOT a global mean/std

preprocessing_snippet: # sar: np.ndarray [2, H, W] — raw linear sigma0 from GeoTIFF

output_contract.tensor_shape: [1, H, W] — same spatial dimensions as input
output_contract.threshold_note: 0.5 is the training default. Calibrate against held-out scenes for your geography.

arrays.sar_input: float32 [2, H, W] — robust_normalize already applied; pass directly to model
arrays.raw_sar: float32 [2, H, W] — original linear sigma0 before normalization (for reference)
arrays.expected_prob_mask: float32 [H, W] — sigmoid(model(sar_input)).squeeze() from the trained model
arrays.gt_mask: uint8  [H, W] — ground-truth oil mask from Zenodo dataset
arrays.threshold: float32 scalar — threshold used to produce expected_binary_mask

integration_test: assert np.allclose(prob, d['expected_prob_mask'], atol=1e-5), 'Integration broken: output mismatch'

training_dataset.name: Zenodo Sentinel-1 SAR Oil Spill Detection Dataset
training_dataset.content: Paired VV+VH GeoTIFFs and binary oil/look-alike segmentation masks

evaluation_metrics.note: Pixel accuracy alone is misleading due to extreme class imbalance. Use dice_f1 and iou as primary indicators.

csiro_chip_verifier.purpose: Second-stage verifier: classifies extracted candidate regions as oil or look-alike. Complements pixel-level segmentation.

metrics.dataset: CSIRO Sentinel-1 Oil/No-Oil Chip Dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0)

guardrails.language: Always use 'potential slick' — never 'confirmed oil spill'.
guardrails.human_review_required: DetectionResult.human_review_required is always True in this system.
guardrails.confidence_note: Confidence is a calibrated signal, not legal evidence.
guardrails.no_heuristic_fallback: Do NOT substitute the heuristic brightness detector for this model in production.
